cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped browser check delays one search response behind another.

cases.quote: a `409 table_unavailable` response shows `booking-error` and refreshes availability. Preserve the selected form and its inputs so the diner can change their choice.
cases.why_not_shipped: the shipped 409 check only looks for booking-error; it never checks the refreshed grid or the preserved inputs.

cases.quote: A successful retry removes the uncertainty/error elements and shows the original reference. A confirmed rejection uses `booking-error`.
cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped browser check retries after a lost request, so a rejected retry is never seen.
